source.chapter_title: Results of the Antardasas in the Mahadasa of Ketu

notes: Each antardasha is judged from the sub-period lord's dignity and house, and its position counted from the mahadasha lord. Warnings attached to lordship of the 2nd/7th (maraka), named diseases, deaths and the remedial rituals that close each section are omitted under the sensitive-topics policy.

rules.text: Ketu-Ketu: Ketu with the ascendant lord in an angle or trine, with the 4th lord in the 11th, or with the 9th or 10th lord — wealth, prosperity and livestock, comfort from spouse and children, official goodwill and an estate or land, though with some mental unease.
Ketu-Ketu: with Ketu debilitated or in the 8th or 12th — damage to reputation, loss of money, provisions and livestock, distress to spouse and children, and anxiety; health needs care.

Ketu-Venus: with Venus in its own sign or exalted, in an angle, trine or the 11th, or with the 10th lord — official goodwill and gifts, a decent vehicle, pilgrimage and intense devotion, and an estate or land through favour.

variants.text: With the 9th or 10th lord: a quick inflow of wealth and recovery of a lost position.
Well placed by house: welfare at home, provisions, clothes and ornaments, and fine conveyances.

rules.note: The printed verse names Ketu where the context requires Venus; encoded for Venus.

rules.text: Ketu-Venus: Venus in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Ketu or with malefics — intangible quarrels and damage to livestock and crops.

variants.text: Venus is also in the 6th or 8th or debilitated: conflict with siblings, disrepute, loss of money and provisions, and distress to spouse and children; health needs care.

rules.text: Ketu-Sun: the Sun dignified or in an angle, trine or the 11th, aspected by a benefic — wealth and prosperity, help at the highest level, great comfort, auspicious activities accomplished and contentment over ambitious plans.

variants.text: The Sun is also well placed from Ketu: physical comfort, money, the birth of a child, a firm heart, success in every sphere and local authority.

rules.text: Ketu-Sun: the Sun with a malefic in the 8th or 12th, or in the 8th or 12th from Ketu — trouble and opposition from authority and friends, worry over the parents, foreign travel, risk of theft, depletion of money and provisions, and fear at heart. The start and middle bring controversy; the end brings happiness.

Ketu-Moon: the Moon exalted or in its own sign, or in an angle, trine, the 2nd or the 11th with benefics — official goodwill, great zeal, welfare and comfort, house and land through favour, large business gains, a vehicle, clothes and ornaments, interest in temples and good works, and comfort from spouse and children; stronger with a bright Moon.

variants.text: A strong Moon in an angle, trine or the 11th: gains of crops, livestock and land, and work accomplished through siblings; the end brings worry over authority and long journeys within the country.

rules.text: Ketu-Moon: the Moon weak, debilitated or in the 6th, 8th or 12th — frustration over personal discomfort, obstruction at work, fearfulness, worry over the parents, mental strain and business losses.

variants.text: A weak Moon in the 6th or 8th from Ketu: loss of wealth, anxiety, and hostility with siblings.

rules.text: Ketu-Mars: Mars in an angle or trine, or exalted or in its own sign, with benefic support — good results from the start: land or an estate, wealth, profit from livestock, house, garden and farmland, and luxury through official favour.

variants.text: Well placed by house: official goodwill, fame, and warmth from children and friends.

rules.text: Ketu-Mars: Mars in the 2nd, 8th or 12th from Ketu — hurdles in going abroad, trouble from authority or theft, quarrels followed by regret, and health needing care; a slight rise in comforts.

Ketu-Rahu: with Rahu dignified or in an angle, trine, the 2nd, 3rd or 11th — gains of money, journeys, a house, happiness through authority, provisions, livestock and land. The start brings conflict; the middle and end bring happiness.
Ketu-Rahu: Rahu in the 8th or 12th under malefic influence — health needs care (weakness and recurring complaints) and there are intangible quarrels.

variants.text: Rahu in the 2nd or 7th: conflicts and great fearfulness.

rules.text: Ketu-Jupiter: with Jupiter in an angle or trine, exalted or in its own sign, or with the 1st, 9th or 10th lord — more wealth, prosperity and comfort, official goodwill, exuberance, a fine vehicle, welfare at home, the birth of a child, a completed pilgrimage, good works, triumph over rivals, and meetings with those in power.

variants.text: Jupiter with benefics, well placed from Ketu: fine clothes and ornaments, a visit to a distant place, support for siblings; physical discomfort at the start and an intangible quarrel at the end.

rules.text: Ketu-Jupiter: Jupiter in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Ketu or debilitated — risk of theft and injury, fear of losing money and provisions, and grief around spouse and children; the start is good and the end distressing.

Ketu-Saturn: with Saturn in the 8th or 12th — distress, disputes among siblings, mental anguish, loss of money through official action, great fear, loss of position or place, residence abroad, risk of theft while travelling, lethargy and loss of confidence.

Ketu-Saturn: Saturn dignified or in an angle, trine, 3rd or 11th, with benefic influence — success in every venture, great affection from the employer, comfortable travel, growing happiness and prosperity locally, and a meeting with authority on home ground.
Ketu-Saturn: Saturn with malefics in the 6th, 8th or 12th — physical and mental strain, disgrace, and grief concerning the parents.

Ketu-Mercury: with Mercury in an angle, trine or the 11th, or exalted or in its own sign — profit from the state, great happiness, religious study and charity, pleasant land, the birth of a child, gains of money, a wedding or other celebration, and clothes and ornaments.

variants.text: With the 9th or 10th lord: a rise in fortune, comforts and time spent in learned debate and religious gatherings.

rules.text: Ketu-Mercury: Mercury in the 6th, 8th or 12th, joined or aspected by Saturn, Mars or Rahu — opposition from officials, having to live in someone else's house, and loss of vehicle, clothes, livestock and money; the start is favourable, the middle brings comfort and gains, and the end brings distress.
Ketu-Mercury: a weak Mercury in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Ketu — severe conflict at the start, distress to spouse and children and fear of authority; a pilgrimage in the middle of the period.
